readout: ridge (alpha=1) on the K=9 CASCADE features; the RNA-FM arm concatenates the 640-d RNA-FM mean-pooled guide embedding

anti_leakage.methodology: siRNADiscovery anti-leakage at the guide-sequence level: any test siRNA whose guide also appears in train is removed (no shared guide across the split)
anti_leakage.transcript_grouped_note: the canonical Huesken 2005 set is 2431 siRNAs across 34 transcripts with a 2182/249 split; the OligoFormer Hu CSV used here carries 2361 siRNAs with a 2182/179 split and a placeholder mrna_id, so the transcript-grouped split is not reproducible from this source.

with_rnafm.source: RNA-FM embeddings unavailable (need the 'fm' package or a precomputed cache at huesken_rnafm_pooled.npy): RNA-FM embeddings need torch and the 'fm' (rna-fm) package, which are not installed. pip install rna-fm torch  (the 'fm' package; see github.com/ml4bio/RNA-FM)
